payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the NER model incorporates both text and images for named entity recognition, as it is described as a multimodal NER system that utilizes visual information alongside textual data.

claims.text: The NER model learns from both text and images by using a multimodal approach that combines visual contexts with textual information.
The proposed multimodal NER system significantly outperforms traditional text-only NER models by leveraging visual information.
